SWORD.name: Sword
SWORD.desc: Close work. A lunge that cuts everything on its line; melee flows hit far harder, and bolts leave the blade sluggish.

GUN.name: Gun
GUN.desc: Range and speed. Bolts fly flat and fast; the stock makes a poor club.

ROCK.name: Rock
ROCK.desc: A thrown stone takes anything. Heavy, arcing, and fussy about nothing.
